Consequently it cannot fuzz SLOTNUM parsing/validation, Amsterdam gating, the uint64 block.slotnum semantics, or either Solidity code-generation path.
evidence: Instruction::SLOTNUM is added at opcode 0x4b with zero arguments and one return value, and c_instructions maps the text "SLOTNUM" to it.
EVMVersion::hasSlotNum() returns true only from EVMVersion::amsterdam(), and both EVMVersion::hasOpcode and AsmAnalyzer::validateInstructions apply that version boundary.

MagicType::nativeMembers adds block member "slotnum" with TypeProvider::uint(64), while ExpressionCompiler::visit and IRGeneratorForStatements::endVisit lower it to Instruction::SLOTNUM and slotnum(), respectively.
H0 maps Program::AMSTERDAM to EVMVersion::amsterdam(), but ProtoConverter::visit(NullaryOp const&) enumerates MSIZE through BLOBBASEFEE and contains no SLOTNUM case or "slotnum()" emission.
H0's other expression visitors likewise contain no visible SLOTNUM or slotnum generation path.
